reference.inp.source: EPANET 2 example network 3 (Net3), US EPA; copied unmodified from wntr 1.5.0 wntr/library/networks/Net3.inp
reference.inp.license: US Government work (EPANET examples, public domain); WNTR is Revised BSD
reference.inp.units: GPM / US customary in the file; the plant converts to SI at load
reference.inp.modifications: none to the file; at load the plant switches demand to PDA with the declared pressures and sets hydraulic step 300 s and duration 48 h

assumptions: Junctions 109, 101 and 119 (largest base demands) are designated essential consumers.
Required pressure 14 m (about 20 psi) and minimum pressure 0 m for pressure-driven demand.
Pump efficiency is EPANET's default (75%) unless the file declares one; electricity use is the EPANET pump energy.
